description.en: Returns the pause bits: each set bit pauses one part of the game (field characters, field camera...), with the same bit values as the draw-off bits. Bits (constants of ie4_ev_main.nut): OFF_RPG_CHARA 1, OFF_RPG_MAP 2, OFF_RPG_CAMERA 4, OFF_EVENT_CHARA 8, OFF_EVENT_MAP 16, OFF_MENU_CHARA 32, OFF_MENU_MAP 64, OFF_RPG_MINIMAP 128, OFF_EVENT_CHIBI 512; groups OFF_RPG, OFF_EVENT, OFF_MENU, OFF_ALL.

The pause bits.
null if the script system is not ready.
